decision: Add a capability-gated XI2 acquisition facade to the existing daemon loop/FSM. Freeze the original master synchronously without XIAllowEvents; the server retains original input on success or rejection. Replay frames use a separately owned master/XTEST pair with exact identity, focus and XKB map/group verification. Other topologies and explicit devices retain evdev.
reason: VNC-only Xvfb has no evdev keyboard. Async slave capture lost input on rejection; an existing output slave freezes with its master. The isolated master-freeze proof justifies the separate replay resource, selection claim and orphan cleanup. No second edit/gesture authority or IME route change.
verification: Remote guarded source checks, isolated X server device/grab proof, independent review and owned real VNC client receipts are required. See docs/development/remote-x11-input-2026-10-20.md for exact evidence and current status.
not_tested: No physical evdev acceptance without a connected keyboard. Unsupported multi-device X11 topologies, Wayland remote input and other VNC servers are not certified by this change. A readiness probe is not client acceptance.
